body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Toshiba presented its new customized consumer laptop 'Qosmio X305-Q725' at CES 2009.

Toshiba Qosmio X305-Q725 is a technically advanced multimedia platform for the gaming and entertainment enthusiast. It features a 17-inch widescreen with TruBrite, high-performance NVIDIA GeForce 9800M GTX graphics1, an Intel Core 2 Quad processor2, a 64GB solid state drive, premium Harman Kardon stereo speakers and more.
The Qosmio X305-Q725 is available now at a variety of major consumer electronics and computer stores nationwide for $2,699.99.
